The candidate lands nothing, binds NOTHING, executes nothing, occupies no identifier, invents no prohibited bytes or adjacent protocol object, takes over no G27 authority, changes no status token or required-now count, opens no Class A, satisfies no row, edits neither protected file, and authorizes no implementation.
